answer_1.quote: In this paper, we work towards the development of a generation module for a virtual peer tutor that ... can produce a tutor's utterance u′i that matches a given hedge strategy (i.e., hedge or non-hedge) ...
datasets: Peer-tutoring dialogue dataset (American teenagers tutoring each other in linear algebra)
answer_1.outputs: Tutor turns labeled as hedge or non‑hedge

answer_2.quote: We used the most widely used set of reference‑based metrics for natural language generation tasks ... BLEU, ROUGE‑L, CHRF, BERTScore, BARTScore, Perplexity.

answer_4.quote: We therefore asked two annotators to ignore sub‑categories and annotate only hedge or non‑hedge on each tutor turn of the model's output, with access to 4 prior turns of the dialogue history. ... The annotators reported no concerns with the naturalness of the generated utterances.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators were instructed to label each generated tutor turn as hedge or non‑hedge and to note if the output was unnatural.
